what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vietnam in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1101 Vietnamese asylum seekers in Canada, 5.7% of all asylum seekers from Vietnam.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 85 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
